g.text: Feynman V Cu Co Ni IL
D2-83388f · build 1.16.244.0 · chart 0 · fixed main definitions
Conditional historical-frame ordinary model · historical winner / loaded epoch UNKNOWN
Saved beacon coincides by zero Workshop compensation. This is a research disk; terrain and final UI availability are not shown.
All source anchors and nominal boxes
Purple +: source anchor. Gray ×: generator origin (anchor −200).
Source layout only; boxes are not deposits.
No source anchor is assumed to be the outpost centre.
Black circle: fixed 150-unit disk. Cross: saved native centre. Diamond: saved beacon in the same representation.
All zoom panels use X right / Y up, centre (0,0), ±240 native units, and 1 pixel per native unit.
Viewport clipping outside the zoom is deliberate; the entire disk is visible. Full exact points/bounds remain in the case JSON.
Observed historically: Copper, Cobalt, Nickel, Ionic Liquids. All four have positive modeled disk area from U01/U02.
Resource colors follow IRES TINC; draw order does not define resource dominance. Marginal native rounding is approximate.
Special Helium-3, Water admission, atmosphere, terrain and other catalogue routes are outside this ordinary comparison.
Historical availability is independent evidence; see the reconciliation report. No Cartesian combination of variants is asserted.
